angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 27,271,440 km at 1990.30 pc = 0.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1990.3 +/- 193.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1990.3 +/- 193.9 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2487 +/- 0.0538 mas (same row, RUWE 2.99), 4.6 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 39.2 +/- 3.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39.2 +/- 3.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 27,271,440 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 412 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 145, Name='RZ Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 412 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 145, Name='RZ Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 412 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 2.2 from 2013MNRAS.428.3252A; the 5 published values span log g 1.73 to 2.36, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013MNRAS.428.3252A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
